summary: Implemented phase 8 of the 11-phase gate-framework refactor (One-Process-Per-File Shellcheck Parallelization), closed cleanly and committed as 290bf659b. lint-shellcheck.sh now dispatches one shellcheck process per file via a wait -n-bounded worker pool (SHELLCHECK_JOBS default 8, env-overridable, chosen from a fresh real-corpus experiment, never a bare nproc). Measured before/after across three same-host A/B pairs: 76778ms->39455ms, 136376ms->45475ms, 75778ms->42006ms/38355ms -- a real 1.8x-3x win with 0 findings on every side (finding-set equivalence, not just timing), additionally proven byte-identical against the pre-change original script via a throwaway git worktree on both the real corpus and a seeded SC2155 fixture. New acceptance suite test-lint-shellcheck-parallel.sh (9 cases, relative-ratio timing gate to survive ambient host contention) passes standalone and via run-all.sh, registered in LOAD_SENSITIVE_BASENAMES. Gate 22 via the full verify-deploy.sh wrapper passes clean against the source store. Broader regression net (6 suites via run-all.sh --jobs auto) passes 6/6. Investigated the coordinator's drift-inspection question directly by reading the code: the Phase 4-deferred CURRENT_GATE global-scoping concern IS genuinely discharged by Phase 7's per-gate-subshell architecture (every gateN_run() sets CURRENT_GATE inside its own forked subshell before any FINDINGS_LIST write, and no other read site exists anywhere in verify-deploy.sh) -- not carried past its own phase as unresolved debt. One disclosed sequencing deviation: the phase-8 handoff markdown was written after the phase-closing commit rather than before, so it is not included in that commit; no second provenance-only commit was created to fix this (would violate the single-commit-per-phase rule from the other direction, and amending is unsafe with other writers live in this repo) -- it sits uncommitted pending Phase 9's first commit. Paused at this clean phase boundary per the coordinator's explicit instruction; Phase 9 (Shared Corpus Enumeration) depends on Phase 7 (complete) and can start cleanly, but its Scope Hypothesis already flags the dispatch's 'six lints share one git ls-files list' framing as confirmed wrong by the research.

artifacts.summary: Phase 8 closing handoff: measured shellcheck before/after table, finding-set-equivalence proof against the pre-change original via a throwaway worktree, the CURRENT_GATE drift-inspection finding (genuinely discharged), and the uncommitted-handoff sequencing deviation.
